rules.sentence: Late neurosyphilis describes neurological manifestations in tertiary syphilis and would include tables dorsalis, Charcot spine (spinal neuroarthropathy), and syphilitic paresis (general paresis, general paralysis of the insane, dementia paralytica).
It accounts for 5% to 10% of all tertiary syphilis cases.
